title: Simply perfect for the goal of implementing habits
body:
Avocation is the best app to help you implement new habits or refresh old ones! And even to loose old habits! The gorgeous interface is also very direct and effective. In a minute you set up your habits and get statistics! Start growing your own plants and you will find out for yourself!
Keep up the good work
author: Carl_NL

title: Cant use it on my Apple Watch
body: Cool app, but too bad it’s not compatible with your Apple Watch
author: kay.leet

title: Amazing
body: I never write these reviews, but I really do love this app! It is so simple and efficient! If I could add one more thing however, I think it would be cool if I could set how quickly my plant grows, and could turn on or off whether my plant will die if I don’t complete my habits.
author: Zyrath
